entry.label: Metasystem Transition Theory
entry.description: A theoretical programme developed within Principia Cybernetica around the repeated emergence of higher levels of control and organisation.
entry.canonical_definition: The Principia editors’ particular cybernetic philosophy, organised around the emergence of new levels of control.

profile.title: Metasystem transition theory
profile.summary: MSTT extends beyond the definition of a transition: its project overview includes epistemology, metaphysics, evolutionary history, predictions, and ethics. It proposes that models are constructed by subjects or groups and selected by their environment.
profile.canonical_definition: The Principia editors’ particular cybernetic philosophy, organised around the emergence of new levels of control.
profile.why_it_matters: Identify which part is a definition, an empirical historical interpretation, a future forecast, or a value commitment.
profile.context_and_lineage: A project-authored account, not evidence of consensus or historical influence.
profile.editorial_note: Paraphrase of attributed authors’ proposals; no endorsement of forecasts or values.
key_distinctions: An example offered as a transition needs independent examination of its claimed control mechanism.
Evolutionary continuation and survival are the authors’ values, not observer-neutral measures of welfare.
common_misreadings: Treating a proposed mechanism or normative commitment as a settled conclusion.
open_checks: Source-located research candidates await human editorial acceptance.
